title: Sparkly pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='blade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#d8f3ff'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#8fd4f0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5aa8cc'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='blade2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#bfe9fb'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#7cc6e6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4f9bc0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e0455f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='handle2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffb3c0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#d13a54'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- top blade (pointing up-right) -->
  <polygon points='50,50 88,16 82,26 52,54' fill='url(#blade)'/>
  <!-- top blade edge highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,50 88,16 85,21 51,52' fill='#eafaff'/>

  <!-- bottom blade (pointing up-left) -->
  <polygon points='50,50 12,16 18,26 48,54' fill='url(#blade2)'/>

  <!-- pivot screw -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2' fill='#c79a2e'/>

  <!-- right handle: arm from pivot down-right -->
  <polygon points='53,54 78,86 70,92 49,58' fill='url(#handle)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='85' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#e0455f'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='85' rx='5' ry='4.5' fill='#2b3a55'/>

  <!-- left handle: arm from pivot down-left -->
  <polygon points='47,54 22,86 30,92 51,58' fill='url(#handle2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='85' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#d13a54'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='85' rx='5' ry='4.5' fill='#2b3a55'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe66d'>
    <polygon points='90,50 92,56 98,58 92,60 90,66 88,60 82,58 88,56'/>
    <polygon points='10,48 12,54 18,56 12,58 10,64 8,58 2,56 8,54'/>
    <polygon points='62,32 63.5,36 68,37 63.5,38 62,42 60.5,38 56,37 60.5,36'/>
    <polygon points='36,34 37.5,38 42,39 37.5,40 36,44 34.5,40 30,39 34.5,38'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffffff'>
    <polygon points='88,74 89,77 92,78 89,79 88,82 87,79 84,78 87,77'/>
    <polygon points='14,74 15,77 18,78 15,79 14,82 13,79 10,78 13,77'/>
  </g>
</svg>
